text:
Marta: Quick sync — VelvetAI wants to list their 7B open model on our marketplace and offer an NVIDIA-bundled image with quantized weights. Need to confirm redistribution + export compliance and announcement plan. Doc: https://docs.google.com/velvetai-integration (working draft).
Sam - Legal: Thanks. Core legal Q: can they allow redistribution of quantized weights? Need license text. Are they proposing permissive (Apache-like) or copyleft?
Marta: They sent a draft dual-license: CC-BY-4.0 for model outputs + a non-exclusive commercial license for weights. They also want us to host/download distribution and allow our customers to pull weights to dedicated infra.
Sam - Legal: Non-exclusive commercial license for weights + redistribution permission to customers is OK but we need: export classification, sanctions check, and a clause preventing rehosting in public CDN mirrors. Also add audit logging for downloads.
Hana (eng): :eyes: Technical notes — if we allow weights download, we need to gate versioned artifacts via signed links and add a download quota. Quantized artifacts (4-bit) may be considered derived; confirm license covers transformations.
Kevin (product): From product: we should avoid customers re-exporting weights via our hosted API (i.e., making a repo). Suggest we offer two modes: 'serve-only' via Redwood (no downloads) for hosted, and a 'approved-download' for Dedicated/Private with extra checks.
Marta: VelvetAI prefers both options. They're open to requiring a reseller agreement for downloads and a marketplace fee split: 70/30 split on any revenue tied to hosted usage, plus fixed listing fee.
Luc (sales): 70/30 is close to our standard. We need to confirm whether listing fee is refundable and how to reflect revenue in marketplace billing. Also check whether we can co-announce.
Sam - Legal: Action items for legal: draft a compact 'download escrow' clause and a rehost prohibition. Suggested language snippet:

```
Distributor may provide model artifacts to End Users solely for deployment within End User-controlled environments under an approved Reseller Agreement. Redistribution, public rehosting, or placement into publicly-accessible mirrors is prohibited. Distributor will log all artifact downloads and provide provenance metadata to Redwood upon request.
```

Need to confirm VelvetAI ok with 'provenance metadata' requirement.
Marta: I'll ping their counsel. Also ops asked about telemetry: VelvetAI wants minimal usage telemetry (top-level counts) for model health and billing. Is that acceptable?
Hana (eng): We can provide anonymized aggregate telemetry (requests per hour, avg latency) but not token-level logs unless customer consents. For downloads, we can return S3 presigned URLs with a ttl and record events in audit logs.
Sam - Legal: Telemetry plan must be explicit in the contract. Customers need opt-in for any non-aggregated logs. Add a data handling appendix.
Marta: Announcement planning: VelvetAI wants a joint blog + webinar two weeks after listing. We should coordinate messaging and embargo. Who owns press release ops?
Luc (sales): Marketing + partnerships to coordinate. I'll draft a timeline: partner review (3 business days), legal sign-off (5 days), integration QA (7 days), press assets (5 days). That hits ~20 business days.
Kevin (product): We also need to prepare listing page: model card, quantization profile, recommended infra (GPU, memory), and cost per 1k tokens on our hosted runtimes. Engineering needs the quantized weight checksum + model config.
Marta: Good — I'll collect weight checksums and the draft model card. Proposed next steps: 1) Marta to confirm license acceptance with VelvetAI; 2) Sam to prepare 'download escrow' + telemetry appendix; 3) Hana to scope gated-download implementation; 4) Kevin/Luc to build listing page and comms timeline. Target: sign-off in 14 business days. @deploy-bot please create a partnership-velvetai ticket.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PART-7289 — VelvetAI marketplace + download gating. Assignees: @Marta, @Sam - Legal, @Hana, @Kevin, @Luc. Due date: 14 business days from 2002123456.
Marta: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll update thread after counsel response.
